label: r3c1
name: 8-frame pool, lr 3e-3
hypothesis: This is r2c1 with lr raised from 2.5e-3 to 3e-3. Going from 1.5e-3 to 2.5e-3 lifted the weak seed from 0.54 to 0.97, and lr 3e-3 with 3 epochs had no collapse. Faster learning within the fixed sample budget may push both seeds closer to 1. Refuted if the mean falls below 0.964 or either seed falls below 0.9 or collapses to 0.078.
